name: capability-grid
purpose: A framed grid of product capabilities under an optional section title: each cell is a `Topic` (glyph, heading, sentence) with optional bullet points, three or four to a row. From the design sample's site `CapabilityGrid`.
useWhen: A product page listing what the product does, three or six at a time.
A bare grid (no title) under a band that already has its heading.
avoidWhen: For capabilities with art — use `FeatureTiles` or `BentoGrid`.
For links to other pages — use `UseCaseLinks` or `ResourceGrid`.
bestPractices: Three or six items at three columns, four or eight at four, so rows stay full.
Keep points to three short lines.

Set `titleKind: 'left'` for a band whose header sits at the start edge (the Partners page's "Why you should be a partner"); the grid keeps its title, so each capability stays an `h3`. Never wrap a bare grid in `SectionModule` to move the title: the capability headings rise to `h2` and the outline breaks.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline over the grid, rendered as the band `h2`; without it the grid is bare and each capability heading is an `h2`.

props.name: description
props.doc: One or two sentences under the title.

props.name: items
props.doc: The capabilities, in order; each is `{ title, description, icon?, points? }`. The band renders nothing when empty.

props.name: columns
props.doc: Capabilities per row from the large breakpoint up.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Buttons under the section title; each is `{ label, href, trailing?, target?, kind? }`; without `kind` the first is secondary and the rest outlined.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a hash link can target it.

props.name: titleKind
props.doc: Layout of the section title: `centered` stacks and centers it, `left` stacks it at the start edge, `horizontal` sets the headline and its description in two columns.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CapabilityGrid from '@aziontech/webkit/capability-grid'

  const items = [
    {
      icon: 'pi pi-bolt',
      title: 'Functions',
      description: 'Run JavaScript and WebAssembly close to every user.'
    },
    {
      icon: 'pi pi-database',
      title: 'Object Storage',
      description: 'Keep files where they are read, with no egress to plan for.'
    },
    {
      icon: 'pi pi-shield',
      title: 'Firewall',
      description: 'Stop bots and attacks before they reach your origin.'
    }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <CapabilityGrid
    eyebrow="Platform"
    title="Everything an application needs, in one place"
    description="Compute, storage and security that deploy together."
    :items="items"
    :actions="[{ label: 'Explore the platform', href: '/platform', trailing: true }]"
  />
</template>

    },
    {
      icon: 'pi pi-lock',

    },
    {
      icon: 'pi pi-chart-line',
      title: 'Observability',
      description: 'Metrics and logs in seconds.',

      icon: 'pi pi-sitemap',
